name: Rave
lineage: Rave developed around collective electronic dance events and DJ culture, connecting acid house, techno, breakbeats and subsequent hard-dance scenes. Its late-1980s and 1990s British history sits within wider international club and sound-system exchanges, with later generations continually revisiting and reshaping the repertoire.
